claimed.body: Sign in to your restaurant's dashboard, or read the documentation.
features.api.description: Connect an MCP client such as Claude Desktop with your own permissions, or issue a scoped API key so your website can show the menu, take orders, and book tables.
features.api.title: API & MCP integrations
features.bilingual.description: A full Arabic interface with right-to-left layout, and English alongside it. Each device can switch language at any time.
features.bilingual.title: Arabic and English
features.cloud.description: Runs on Cloudflare's global network — no server to install, update, or back up yourself. Every device needs an internet connection.
features.cloud.title: Hosted in the cloud
features.crm.description: Customer profiles, earn-and-redeem loyalty points, gift cards, and full visit history.
features.crm.title: Customers, loyalty & gift cards
features.delivery.description: Take delivery orders alongside dine-in and takeaway, assign drivers, and track each order's status.
features.delivery.title: Delivery
features.heading: Everything a restaurant needs, in one place
features.inventory.description: Ingredients, recipe costing, purchase orders, goods receipt with batch tracking, and waste logging.
features.inventory.title: Inventory & purchasing
features.kds.description: Orders reach the right kitchen station the moment they're placed, with priority and reprint controls and prep-time reporting.
features.kds.title: Real-time kitchen display
features.pos.description: Modifiers, combos, split and merged bills, tips, and multi-tender checkout. Staff record cash, card, mada, STC Pay, and Apple Pay payments.
features.pos.title: Point of sale & billing
features.qr.description: Per-table QR codes let guests browse the menu and order from their phones, and a self-service kiosk takes orders at the counter.
features.qr.title: QR ordering & kiosk
features.reports.description: Sales and operations reports, staff accounts with granular role-based permissions, and attendance tracking.
features.reports.title: Reports, staff & roles
features.subheading: Purpose-built for dine-in, takeaway, and kitchen operations — not a retail checkout adapted for restaurants.
features.tables.description: A visual floor plan, table transfers, and reservations with a waitlist.
features.tables.title: Tables & reservations
features.vat.description: Prices in SAR, VAT-inclusive, with 15% VAT by default. Receipts print as simplified tax invoices with a ZATCA Phase 1 QR code.
features.vat.title: Saudi VAT & ZATCA QR
footer.copyright: © {year} Nodedr Infotech Private Limited. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.
footer.tagline: Cloud-hosted restaurant management for Saudi Arabia, in Arabic and English. Built by Nodedr Infotech Private Limited.
hero.subtitle: POS, kitchen display, tables, QR ordering, reservations, inventory, and reports — in one cloud app, in Arabic and English, with VAT-inclusive SAR pricing and a ZATCA Phase 1 QR code on every receipt.
mockup.title: Kitchen Display
nav.label: Main
security.audit.description: An audit log records who made key changes — API keys, cash closings, coupons and promotions, payroll, and more — and when.
security.audit.title: Audit log
security.docs.description: A written accessibility statement and Saudi VAT / ZATCA compliance notes you can read for yourself.
security.docs.title: Documented, not just claimed
security.heading: Security built in
security.isolation.description: Every record belongs to one restaurant, and every query is scoped to it — one restaurant's staff can never see another's data.
security.isolation.title: Per-restaurant data isolation
security.money.description: Prices, VAT, discounts, and totals are always recalculated on the server — never trusted from the device.
security.money.title: Server-calculated totals
security.rbac.description: Granular permissions you switch on per role, checked on the server for every action — not just hidden buttons.
security.rbac.title: Role-based permissions
security.signin.description: Hashed passwords, rate-limited sign-in, httpOnly session cookies, and optional two-factor authentication.
security.signin.title: Secure sign-in
security.subheading: The controls that protect your restaurant's data, described plainly.
showcase.heading: See it in action
start.heading: Up and running in four steps
start.internetNote: OrderRestro is cloud-hosted, so there is nothing to install — but every device (POS, kitchen display, kiosk, and your guests' phones for QR ordering) needs a working internet connection.
start.orders.description: Take orders at the POS, from table QR codes, or at the kiosk — the kitchen display updates in real time.
start.orders.title: Take orders
start.qr.description: Generate a QR code for each table and print it, so guests can open your menu from their phones.
start.qr.title: Print your QR codes
start.setup.description: Add your categories and items with VAT-inclusive SAR prices, your VAT number, and your floors and tables.
start.setup.title: Set up your menu and tables
start.signup.description: Create an account for your restaurant and invite your staff with the roles they need.
start.signup.title: Sign up
start.subheading: No hardware server, no installation — sign up and start serving.
